name: Ajax instant buy checkout for WooCommerce
author: Bss

sections.description:
Ajax instant buy checkout for WooCommerce sostituisce il comportamento del pulsante acquista.
Con un sempllice click il prodotto verrà inserito nel carrello che comparirà in una finestra assieme all’intero checkout.
permettendo cosi di completare la vendita in un unico passaggio e non dover ricaricare molteplici pagine.

Ajax instant buy checkout for WooCommerce replaces the buy button behavior.
With a simple click, the product will be added to the cart which will appear in a modal window together with the entire checkout.
thus allowing you to complete the sale in a single step and not having to reload multiple pages.

Improvements

  1. Use less bandwidth
  2. Reduce server load
  3. Speed user experience
  4. Increase your sales!
